findings.evidence: isAdmin trusts the client-supplied x-admin header, allowing any unauthenticated request to claim admin access.
webhookOk compares only the first 8 hex characters of the HMAC with startsWith, so truncated signatures can pass and full verification is not performed.
invoiceQuery concatenates tenantId and invoiceId into SQL, permitting quote-based injection and cross-tenant data access.
overLimit uses requestCount > 6, so the sixth request in a window is allowed instead of blocked.
